DT POS Enterprise — brand guide

Smarter Business with Digital Target. One mark, one app icon, one set of colours — on the software, the owner portal, the invoices and every phone app. Generated from src/lib/brand.ts.

1 · The mark and the lockup

Four right triangles in a square. It is always drawn as a shape, never as a picture, and takes one flat colour.

2 · App icons

The same artwork — a squircle with a soft gradient, a light glow, and the white mark — in one colour per app. The three phone apps add a white badge with their job: a bag for the customer, a motorbike for the rider, an order pad for the order taker.

5 · Using it

 

Do

  • Use the mark as an SVG, in white on a brand colour or in purple on white.
  • Put the mark and the wordmark directly on the colour — no tile behind them.
  • Show a restaurant's own logo beside Powered by Digital Target.
  • Read colours from src/lib/brand.ts or the theme tokens.

Don't

  • Place a picture of the old logo on a coloured square.
  • Redraw, rotate, outline, stretch or add a shadow to the mark.
  • Put the mark on a colour it does not read on (below 3 : 1).
  • Type the phone numbers or the e-mail into a screen — import them from the brand file.

6 · What is in the kit

PathWhat
branding/icons/*.svgthe four app icons — the master artwork recoloured, with the app's job in a badge for the three phone apps
branding/marks/*.svgthe mark alone: white, purple, ink
branding/export/<app>/1024, 512 (store), 192, maskable 512; for the POS also Apple 180 and favicons
branding/export/android/<App>/res/drop-in Android resources: mipmap-* (legacy, round, adaptive foreground), drawable-port-* / drawable-land-* splash, values/ic_launcher_background.xml
scripts/brand/build-brand-assets.mjsregenerates all of the above from src/lib/brand.ts
